specs.Compatible Devices: Camera, Flashlight, MP3 Player, Table Lamp, Tablet

features: [Efficient charging capacity]: The ZEB-MB10000S4 power bank boasts a significant 10000mAh battery capacity and rapid 2A input/output, ensuring swift and efficient charging to minimize downtime.
[Intuitive Design]: The ZEB-MB10000S4 features a sleek design with a textured finish, enhancing its appearance and providing a comfortable grip.

[Dual device charging]: The ZEB-MB10000S4 stands out with its dual USB output ports, allowing users to charge two devices simultaneously, providing a convenient solution for powering up multiple gadgets quickly.
[LED display]: With its LED percentage display, this power bank provides us with information about how much battery capacity is left.
[Rapid charging]: By adopting advanced charging standards and offering both Type C and micro USB input options, the ZEB-MB10000S4 ensures fast charging with its USB to Type-C cable.
